# The error index

Every code that Stilt's diagnostics carry, each with a page that says what it means and what to do about it, shows a program that makes the mistake and the same program fixed, and gives what the compiler prints. `stilt show CODE` prints the same help and examples in the terminal. Each example is checked as the guide's are, by `just guide`, and each rendering by `just diagnostics`.

## Lexical structure

| Code | Title |
| --- | --- |
| [E0001](E0001.md) | invalid source text |
| [E0002](E0002.md) | unexpected character |
| [E0003](E0003.md) | identifier without a letter |
| [E0004](E0004.md) | malformed number literal |
| [E0005](E0005.md) | unterminated string literal |
| [E0006](E0006.md) | invalid escape |
| [E0007](E0007.md) | malformed format spec |
| [E0008](E0008.md) | nesting too deep |
| [W0001](W0001.md) | commented-out code |
| [W0002](W0002.md) | stale doc |
